name: aidlc
description: AIDLC: AI Development Life Cycle — Inception → Construction (design, build) → Operations, in bolts

phases.name: Inception
phases.description: Mob Elaboration: AI turns business intent into requirements and units of work, the team validates

has_units_of_work.description: Inception must decompose intent into a '## Units of Work' section — a bolt is scoped from one unit

has_open_questions.description: AI must record the questions it asked the team, and their answers, under '## Clarifications'

gate.name: intent-approval
gate.description: Mob Elaboration sign-off: the team confirms the requirements and units of work match the business intent

phases.name: Construction: Logical Design
phases.description: AI proposes logical architecture and domain model, one plan phase per unit of work

has_domain_model.description: Logical design must name the types and invariants it introduces under '## Domain Model'

gate.name: design-approval
gate.description: The team validates the logical architecture before any code is written

phases.name: Construction: Mob Construction
phases.description: One bolt per unit of work: AI writes code and tests, the team clarifies in real time

build.description: Compilation must succeed before the bolt is verified

tests.description: Full test suite — this project has no separate e2e stage

fmt.description: Formatting is mechanical; fix it in the bolt rather than deferring

clippy.description: Lint clean, matching the CI gate

phases.name: Operations
phases.description: Release readiness and retrospective: AI proposes the build/release path, the team oversees

release_build.description: The artifact users actually run must build

review_has_context_updates.description: Operations must record what the next bolt inherits (rustdoc, features, settings), or why nothing changed

review_has_bolt_retrospective.description: Record where AI proposals needed human correction, so the next bolt starts better informed

gate.name: operations-approval
gate.description: Human oversight of the release: the team approves shipping the bolt

PHASE_COMPLETE.description: Signal the current bolt's build step is complete

CLARIFICATION_NEEDED.description: AI has a question only the team can answer; the bolt pauses rather than guessing
